summary: An ancestor of Maria d'Ambrosio who died before 1819; not an ancestor of John himself.
bio: Arcangiola Giordano died before 1819. She is recorded as an ancestor of Maria d'Ambrosio, but she is not an ancestor of John himself. Giordano was the most common surname among the emigrants from Guardia Lombardi, with thirty-nine recorded arrivals in America between 1830 and 1912.
